build_NCSNpp_model: build an NCSNpp score-based generative model with configurable U-Net architecture and Fourier embeddings
run_NCSNpp_forward: run the NCSNpp forward pass with complex inputs x, y and timestep t
review_NCSNpp_preprocess: review the NCSNpp _preprocess method that converts complex x and y into four channel dimensions
review_NCSNpp_postprocess: review the NCSNpp _postprocess method that converts four channel output back to complex tensor
refactor_NCSNpp_output_layer: refactor the NCSNpp output layer to change the final convolution kernel size or padding
